en.title: Maximize Capped Contribution Sum
en.description:
The initial value is Σmin(a[i],b[i]); you may choose at most k distinct positions and change b[i] there to 2b[i]. Find the maximum total.

Semantics follow the original OAMaster problem. The input protocol and any ranges or guarantees marked "site-added" were compiled by this site and do not mean the original problem provided these limits.
en.input: n,k (1≤n≤200000, 0≤k≤n), followed by two lines of n integers each, in the range −10⁹..10⁹ (site-added; negative numbers are allowed).
en.output: Output the maximum total, using a 64-bit integer.
en.explanation: See the accompanying editorial for the approach, proof of correctness, and complexity.
